title: Scheduling Chronic Patient Refill & Follow-Up Reminders

intro.title: Patient Refill & Follow-Up Reminders
intro.subtitle: Automate refill alerts, follow-up check-ins, WhatsApp scheduling, and one-click dispatch

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 7, Part 3: Scheduling Chronic Patient Refill and Follow-Up Reminders. Ensuring chronic disease patients never run out of maintenance medicines builds loyalty and steady monthly revenue.
Go to Reminders. The dashboard highlights due reminders alongside scheduled dates, communication channels, and delivery statuses.
Click Schedule Reminder. Enter the customer's name, mobile number, specific maintenance medicine, and the target refill date.
Choose the notification channel: WhatsApp, SMS, or Both. Customize the personalized message inviting the patient to reorder before their doses run out.
Save the reminder. Use Send Due Reminders to dispatch pending alerts immediately or let the daily automated cron handle dispatch. In Part 4, we connect WhatsApp Cloud API!

outro.takeaway: Patient Refill Reminders: Proactively schedule medicine refills via WhatsApp and SMS to safeguard patient health and maximize pharmacy retention.
